data.long_meaning: The name Binaya is derived from the Sanskrit word 'binayate', which means 'to bring new light'. This name is often given to a child born at a time when new light is needed in the family or in the world. The name Binaya carries the meaning “Brings new light” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Binaya usually hope their child will grow to embody brings new light and live with faith, good character and purpose.
